verdict.rationale: Fellow records, transcribes and summarizes meetings, so clipping and sharing a call moment is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the pack documents cutting a soundbite or highlight clip from a recording, or sharing a segment instead of the whole recording. The 'highlights' in Fellow Markdown are note-content formatting, and timestamped transcripts are raw data a developer could build on; neither is a clip-sharing feature.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can cut a soundbite or highlight clip from a call and share that moment instead of the whole recording
